summary: Harrow, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the October 1, 2026 closing of its acquisition of TYRVAYA (varenicline nasal spray 0.03 mg) from Viatris Inc., covering worldwide rights excluding Japan. The parties amended and restated the August 3, 2026 asset purchase agreement, eliminating the net-working-capital purchase price adjustment and fixing cash consideration at $30.0 million, funded from cash on hand, plus up to $70.0 million in contingent milestone payments tied to net sales thresholds over twelve-month periods ending on or before December 31, 2029. Viatris retained Japanese commercialization rights and pays Harrow tiered royalties on Japanese net sales under a side letter; ancillary transition services and IP assignment agreements were signed. What to watch: milestone achievement risk, integration of the new drug application, and whether TYRVAYA sales ramp supports the contingent consideration.
